title: Report a text button repeated on every row of a list (repeated-row-action)
notes: Seen on InteliFactu's fiscal review, 2026-10-12: "Documentos candidatos" on every row, a column of identical words. Candidate: 4 or more rows carrying a byte-identical button label should be an icon with a tooltip. Smallest next step: a fixture with the repeated label and a clean one, then the rule as a warning.
